verdict.rationale: The evidence documents MailerLite's email editors (drag & drop, Simple, HTML) and an AI builder only for landing pages. The Claude/MCP integration lets an external assistant act on MailerLite, which is not built-in AI inside the email composer. Nothing in the pack shows AI drafting or refining subject lines or email copy from a brief, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
